name: @tpmjs/tools-image-gen
description: Generate and describe images with whichever AI provider you have a key for — OpenAI, Gemini/Imagen, fal.ai or Replicate — and deliver results as URLs (Discord) instead of megabytes of base64

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google AI Studio key (Imagen 3 and Gemini vision)

env.name: FAL_KEY
env.description: fal.ai key (FLUX models; returns hosted URLs)

env.name: REPLICATE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Replicate token (FLUX models; returns hosted URLs)

env.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
env.description: If set, generated images are posted there and returned as durable Discord CDN URLs

env.name: IMAGE_PROVIDER
env.description: Force a provider: openai | gemini | fal | replicate (default: first configured, preferring URL-returning providers)

tools.name: generateImage
tools.description: Generate one or more images from a prompt using the first configured provider, returning URLs (via Discord delivery or the provider) or inline data.

tools.name: describeImage
tools.description: Describe an image or answer a question about it using a vision model (OpenAI or Gemini).
